_doc: Expansion 1 (Vharlen). The two named rares of every zone in Vharlen (data/provinces/vharlen.json, same order as its zones). Laid over data/provinces/rares.json for Vharlen. Each id is a script in data/encounters/<id>.json with tier "rare" and secret true. PLAN §3.4: 20-60 min respawn per copy, roaming paths, called out in zone chat.
